blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu – Twenty-seven graduates from universities and colleges in Cebu landed among the Top 10 passers of the September 2026 Psychometrician Licensure Examination (PMLE). The topnotchers represented various higher education institutions across Cebu, with multiple examinees sharing the same ranks and ratings.
